parameters.name: DeliveryDetail
parameters.description:
The content of the log delivery configuration. Set the value to a JSON string that contains multiple parameters.

>  This parameter is the same as the **DeliveryDetail** parameter of the **CreateLogDeliveryConfig** operation. For more information, see **Parameter description for log delivery configuration** of the [CreateLogDeliveryConfig](~~CreateLogDeliveryConfig~~) operation.

parameters.name: DeliveryName
parameters.description: The name of the log delivery configuration that you want to modify.

parameters.name: DeliveryType
parameters.description:
The type of the log delivery configuration that you want to modify. Valid values:

*   **syslog**: Logs are delivered to a syslog service.
*   **kafka**: Logs are delivered to a Kafka service.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the WAF instance. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-log-delivery-config --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --delivery-name test1 --delivery-type syslog --delivery-detail rfcVersion_:_rfc3164_,_protocol_:_tcp_,_servers_:_address_:_1.1.1.1_,_port_:_20 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyLogDeliveryConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --DeliveryName test1 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DeliveryDetail 'rfcVersion_:_rfc3164_,_protocol_:_tcp_,_servers_:_address_:_1.1.1.1_,_port_:_20' --DeliveryType syslog
